characters.name: The Widow's Son
characters.prompt: A young, humble Norwegian boy with simple clothes, a curious and brave expression; he holds a sense of innocence and determination in his eyes.

characters.name: The Stranger/Troll
characters.prompt: A mysterious, imposing figure with a shadowy presence; wears dark robes, and has an aura of hidden power and menace. His eyes hint at secrets he keeps.

characters.name: The Horse
characters.prompt: A majestic and intelligent horse with a gleaming, strong build; has a mystical appearance with a wise and loyal expression, intertwined with hints of magical origins.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.prompt: A young and beautiful Norwegian princess with an aura of elegance and kindness; she has fair hair and a gentle smile, indicative of her noble birth.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A regal, authoritative figure with a commanding presence; he wears a kingly regalia, and has an expression of wisdom and sternness with a hint of worry for his kingdom.
